upload_channels.description: Materialize one reviewed local image as an inline Data URL.

tool_targets.description: Generate one image with GPT Image 2 through the verified APIKEY.FAN SSE endpoint.

size.description: Requested aspect-ratio carrier; actual output dimensions are provider-managed.

extension_profile.summary: Generate a new image with GPT Image 2; this target is available while the GPT Image node keeps the model enabled.
characteristics: Strong complex-UI composition and comparatively accurate Chinese text in verified samples.
constraints: Reference-image generation is not exposed because the APIKEY.FAN request shape has not been verified.
limitations: Requested size is not a pixel guarantee; verified outputs normalize to about 1.57 million pixels.
2048x1152 and 3840x2160 both produced 1672x941; high quality did not produce native 4K.

tool_targets.description: Generate one image with the standard Grok Imagine image model through the verified synchronous APIKEY.FAN endpoint.

extension_profile.summary: Generate one standard-cost Grok Imagine image with a reviewed aspect ratio.
constraints: Exactly one image and resolution 1k are sent.
limitations: UI text accuracy varied in the single verified sample.
The route does not expose the unavailable grok-imagine-edit model.

tool_targets.description: Generate one image with the independent high-quality Grok Imagine model through the verified synchronous APIKEY.FAN endpoint.

extension_profile.summary: Generate one image with the independently billed Grok Imagine quality model.
characteristics: Verified sample had stronger Chinese UI organization than the standard model.
Independent model ID rather than a quality flag on the standard model.
constraints: Exactly one image and resolution 1k are sent.
limitations: One sample is not a permanent quality guarantee.
Verified raw cost ticks were 2.5 times the standard image model.

tool_targets.description: Generate a Grok Imagine video through the verified APIKEY.FAN asynchronous start, poll, and authenticated content route.

extension_profile.summary: Generate text-to-video, single-image-to-video, or reviewed multi-reference video with Grok Imagine Video.
characteristics: Asynchronous generation with authenticated binary content download.
Single-image mode preserves the input image aspect ratio.
constraints: Multi-reference mode accepts at most seven images and three voice IDs and requires prompt plus aspect_ratio.
Video editing and extension endpoints are not exposed.
limitations: The ordinary 15-second ceiling must not be interpreted as a verified 15-second multi-reference guarantee.
480p is supported by configuration evidence; the completed live samples used 720p and two seconds.

tool_targets.description: Generate a Grok Imagine Video 1.5 video through the APIKEY.FAN asynchronous start, poll, and authenticated content route.

limitations: The ordinary 15-second ceiling must not be interpreted as a verified 15-second multi-reference guarantee.

tool_targets.description: Generate one image with GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst, the higher-quality sibling tuned for editing precision and tighter multi-turn control, at substantially longer latency than GPT Image 2.5 Flare.

size.description: Requested aspect-ratio carrier; actual output dimensions are provider-managed.

extension_profile.summary: Generate a new image with GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst, the higher-quality GPT Image 2.5 sibling: it is tuned for editing precision and premium visual workflows and is what the provider image-gen skill package ships as its default image model. Generation takes substantially longer than GPT Image 2.5 Flare, while per-token pricing is identical.
characteristics: Streaming base64 image delivery over the verified /images/generations route.
Higher visual quality than GPT Image 2.5 Flare, at substantially longer generation time.
Per-token pricing is identical to GPT Image 2.5 Flare, so the difference is latency rather than cost.
constraints: Reference-image and masked-edit inputs are not exposed.
limitations: Requested size is not a pixel guarantee; output dimensions remain provider-managed.
Prefer GPT Image 2.5 Flare when turnaround time matters more than the last increment of quality.
